unresolvedMapping.identity: Need complete queue/reference/component columns and page/table locators. Do not deduplicate repeated queue IDs or cross-source names.
unresolvedMapping.owner: Need exact owner-column headers, abbreviations and ownership footnotes. Composite listed entities cannot become a single inferred owner.
unresolvedMapping.lifecycle: Need current firm/non-firm and recently in-service/removed categories and definitions. Planning inclusion is not actual construction.
unresolvedMapping.dates: Need report as-of and proposed-season/year notes. No exact day or construction interval may be inferred.
unresolvedMapping.voltageAndRatings: Need operating/design kV definitions and separate MW/MVA/thermal-rating units. No unit substitution.
unresolvedMapping.recordKind: Need row scope to distinguish physical transmission, ancillary/planning context and retirements.
unresolvedMapping.locations: No native geometry inspected. Endpoint names/maps do not supply coordinates, point role, CRS or accuracy.
unresolvedMapping.newScopeBeyondNationalGrid: Intended target includes other owners/merchant/downstate/LongIsland scopes, but no 2026 incremental record count or identity overlap can be established yet.
